div.head: Grið 31
div.ab: ⁊ þonne is rihtlic eac, þæt ure ælce oðerne healde mid rihte, ⁊ þæt ælc cyrice sy æfre on Godes ealmihtiges griðe ⁊ on ealles Cristenes folces.
And þonne is rihtlic eac þæt ure ælce oðerne healde mid rihte, and þæt ælc cyrice sy æfre on Godes ealmihtiges griðe and on ealles Cristenes folces.
Und ferner ist auch richtig, dass jeder von uns den andern rechtmässig behandle, und dass jede Kirche immer im Sonderschutze des allmächtigen Gottes und des ganzen christlichen Volkes sei.
And further it is also right that each of us treat the other lawfully, and that every church be always under the special protection of Almighty God and of all the Christian people.
And then it is also right that each of us treat one another with justice, and that every church be ever in the protection of God almighty and of all Christian people.
